WITH borrower_loan AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_commit AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to >= DATE('now'))
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(bl.loan_amount, 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(gc.guarantee_amount, 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM party p
JOIN borrower_loan bl ON bl.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN guarantor_commit gc ON gc.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.guarantee_amount > bl.loan_amount
ORDER BY gc.guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE gc.status = '有效'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party AS p
JOIN person_profile AS pp
    ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    egtc.name_zh AS group_type_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS distinct_member_count
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN exposure_group eg
    ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN institution i
    ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog egtc
    ON egtc.group_type = eg.group_type
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    eg.group_type,
    egtc.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY distinct_member_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
    AND pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh LIKE '%影子股东%'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 客户编号 ASC;

SELECT
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) AS source_agreement_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id) AS target_agreement_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN credit_agreement ca_s
    ON ca_s.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca_t
    ON ca_t.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, ca.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset ca
WHERE ca.status = '有效'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
        AND cl.status = '有效'
  )
ORDER BY ca.collateral_id ASC;

WITH active_guarantees AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to >= date('now'))
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
own_loan_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(ag.total_guaranteed, 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ole.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS own_loan_amount,
    ROUND(ag.total_guaranteed - COALESCE(ole.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS excess_guarantee_amount
FROM active_guarantees ag
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ag.party_id
LEFT JOIN own_loan_exposure ole ON ole.party_id = ag.party_id
WHERE ag.total_guaranteed > COALESCE(ole.total_loan_balance, 0)
ORDER BY excess_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
        ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca
        ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
      AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
)
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC;

WITH overdue_borrowers AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.overdue_principal IS NOT NULL
      AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
overdue_party AS (
    SELECT
        party_id,
        SUM(total_overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM overdue_borrowers
    GROUP BY party_id
)
SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS obligor_party_id,
    op.total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN overdue_party op ON op.party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, op.total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type AS 担保方式,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS 担保合同笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so
    ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.status = '有效'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY 被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) AS total_inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_holding_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.fair_value IS NOT NULL
  AND phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY total_inversion_amount DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    od.overdue_principal_total
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS overdue_principal_total
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld
        ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca
        ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id
) od
    ON od.borrower_party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ma.issuer_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND od.agreement_id IN (
      SELECT ca2.agreement_id
      FROM credit_agreement ca2
      WHERE ca2.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
  )
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = '有效'
  AND (cl.effective_to IS NULL OR cl.effective_to >= date('now'))
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND fs.total_assets <> 0
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    institution_id,
    ROUND(tier1_capital * 1.0 / risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_capital_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot
WHERE risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND risk_weighted_assets <> 0
  AND tier1_capital IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = cs.as_of_date
WHERE fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND fs.total_assets <> 0
ORDER BY net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.annual_revenue,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot fs2 JOIN institution i2 ON fs2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i2.institution_id), 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot fs2 JOIN institution i2 ON fs2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i2.institution_id) > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ma.originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM managed_asset AS ma
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating <> ma.external_rating
GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot AS phs
JOIN managed_asset AS ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit AS td
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution AS i
    ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm
    ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = '固定雇佣'
  AND so.authority_level IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 2) AS under_provision_pct
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY under_provision_pct DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND rc.classification_basis = '人工认定'
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT
    ld.institution_id AS institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.loan_id) AS nonperforming_loan_count,
    SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || ca.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = ds.as_of_date
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY ca.institution_id
HAVING SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / MAX(fs.annual_revenue) > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

WITH loan_principal AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_account_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        a.institution_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
    WHERE ld.closed_on IS NULL
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
          FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
          WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      )
),
institution_loan_total AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_principal
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.risk_weighted_assets
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(cs2.as_of_date)
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    )
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ilt.total_principal,
    lc.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(ilt.total_principal * 1.0 / lc.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_pct
FROM institution_loan_total ilt
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ilt.institution_id
JOIN latest_capital lc ON lc.institution_id = ilt.institution_id
WHERE lc.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND lc.risk_weighted_assets <> 0
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_pct DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC, pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pm.record_id) AS exception_count,
    SUM(pm.amount_value) AS exception_amount,
    fs.net_assets AS net_capital,
    fs.total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pm.amount_value) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pm
JOIN institution i
    ON i.institution_id = pm.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || pm.institution_id
WHERE pm.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY pm.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(pm.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

WITH
-- 监管报送事项中已逾期未完成记录（按机构统计）
reg_overdue AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_cnt
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3
    WHERE deadline_date IS NOT NULL
      AND completion_date IS NULL
      AND date(deadline_date) < date('now')
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
-- 各借据最新拨备快照
latest_provision AS (
    SELECT
        p.loan_id,
        p.required_amount,
        p.recognized_amount,
        p.as_of_date
    FROM provision_snapshot p
    JOIN (
        SELECT loan_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM provision_snapshot
        GROUP BY loan_id
    ) m
      ON p.loan_id = m.loan_id AND p.as_of_date = m.max_date
),
-- 拨备不足的借据（缺口 = 应提 - 已提 > 0）
underprovisioned AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        (lp.required_amount - lp.recognized_amount) AS shortfall
    FROM latest_provision lp
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lp.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lp.required_amount > lp.recognized_amount
),
-- 按机构汇总拨备不足情况
inst_shortfall AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS underprovisioned_loan_cnt,
        SUM(shortfall) AS total_shortfall,
        AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall
    FROM underprovisioned
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ro.overdue_cnt AS regulatory_overdue_cnt,
    ROUND(ish.avg_shortfall, 2) AS avg_shortfall_amount,
    ish.underprovisioned_loan_cnt,
    ROUND(ish.total_shortfall, 2) AS total_shortfall_amount
FROM inst_shortfall ish
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ish.institution_id
JOIN reg_overdue ro ON ro.institution_id = ish.institution_id
WHERE ro.overdue_cnt >= 25
ORDER BY ish.total_shortfall DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS credit_facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN g.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount_total,
    ROUND(AVG(g.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf
    ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 g
    ON g.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY exception_amount_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS related_target_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_unrelated_relation_count
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY related_target_count DESC, relation_type_count DESC, customer_name ASC;

WITH card_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS cardholder_count
    FROM payment_card pc
    JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
op_risk_stats AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_op_risk_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
    FROM operational_risk_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 43
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(cs.valid_card_count, 0) AS valid_card_count,
    COALESCE(cs.cardholder_count, 0) AS cardholder_count,
    COALESCE(ors.exception_amount, 0) AS exception_amount,
    ors.valid_op_risk_count
FROM op_risk_stats ors
JOIN institution i ON ors.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN card_stats cs ON ors.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.product_id END) AS on_sale_product_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount END), 0) AS total_actual_raise,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pce
    ON pce.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE pce.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pce.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise DESC;

WITH asset_stats AS (
    SELECT
        originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS asset_count,
        ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(issued_amount, 0)), 2) AS total_issued_amount
    FROM managed_asset
    GROUP BY originator_institution_id
),
custody_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ma.originator_institution_id AS institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_record_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ma.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ma.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exception_record_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ma.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ma.exception_flag = 1 THEN COALESCE(ma.issued_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
    FROM managed_asset ma
    WHERE ma.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    a.asset_count,
    a.total_issued_amount,
    c.valid_record_count,
    c.exception_amount
FROM asset_stats a
JOIN custody_stats c ON a.institution_id = c.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE c.exception_record_count >= 2
ORDER BY a.total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
